_note: What is on screen is ranked (docs/design/ARPG_FUN.md P0 item 4). Rank 1 and 2 hues are RESERVED: her own effects never use them (tests/TeleRankTests.cs checks her school hues stay clear). color = the edge's hue; bed = the dark ground under it; edge = emission energy of the edge; fill = fill energy (rank 1) or its share of the edge (rank 2); flare = the edge's lift as the blow lands; raise = the raising's ring edge; charge = a fodder charge lane's edge (the old lowered red, 0.45 x 0.75).
